events.title: Heart Fabel Developer Live Stream
events.summary: This is a 2D side-scrolling simulation-management game. The whole city is split open in cross-section, and inside every room you can watch the Shanhai folk live their daily lives — who's sleeping, who's cooking, each going about their day. Drag a box to carve out a room, then place beds and build stoves. Roads, ladders, hanging baskets — everything slots in right where you want it. events.title: Hearth Fable Demo Out Now — Available on Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello, friends from all corners of the world!We are a small indie startup, and we're thrilled to bring our game Hearth Fable to this edition of Steam Next Fest.We've made a management sim themed around the Classic of Mountains and Seas.
